products.name: Service Attempt Planner
products.product: A focused process serving attempt planning and tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent process-serving agencies and small field-server teams
products.problem: Documents, subject identity, addresses, access details, due dates, attempt history, client instructions, and field safety notes are coordinated manually.
products.valueProposition: Turns process serving attempt planning and tracking into a visible operating queue so every open service job has a current permitted attempt plan, complete documents, owner, and due-time awareness.
products.topic: process serving attempt planning and tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
